title: The Glass Bead Game
author: Hermann Hesse
summary: In the future province of Castalia, an order of scholars devotes itself to an elaborate game that blends music, mathematics and art. Joseph Knecht rises to become its master and begins to question the cloistered life.
readIf: you like intellectual, reflective novels about learning, art and the price of withdrawing from the world.
skipIf: you need a lot of action or conventional character drama.
